newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian killed after attacking Jewish settlers.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian killed after attacking Jewish settlers.

text.p: Jewish settlers shot and killed a Palestinian who attacked Israelis inside a settlement in the West Bank on Tuesday, Israeli security sources said.
They said the Palestinian knifed several settlers at the Elon Moreh settlement near Nablus before being shot dead. No other details were immediately available.
The Israeli army said it was checking the report.
Around 130,000 Jewish settlers live among one million Palestinians in the West Bank which Israel captured in the 1967 Middle East war.
